source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The owned attempt focuses the active attendee element and waits one tick before typing. Accepted source later waits for input.mController?.input, focuses the captured input and awaits that condition. A tick alone does not establish the connection condition. The bug later reports further failures, so preserve the repair phases without claiming this attempt fixed the intermittent test.
title: Attendee focus, a tick and autocomplete connection are different readiness steps
